review_basis: Actual GitHub-hosted Chromium player-height PNGs were visually inspected, not inferred from tests or image metrics.

critical_defects.title: The player sees an empty beige sky instead of a credible exterior world
critical_defects.what_is_visible: Most of each frame is a uniform beige field. The playable foreground occupies a narrow lower strip.
critical_defects.why_it_fails: It recreates the rejected empty-world failure in a different colour. There is no layered horizon, atmospheric hierarchy or sense of a larger harbour district.
critical_defects.required_fix: Replace the flat sky treatment with physically shaded atmosphere and raise/contrast lower, adjacent and distant city silhouettes in normal player sight lines. Capture a fresh look-around from the same spawn after the change.

critical_defects.title: The route reads as giant mustard blockout geometry
critical_defects.what_is_visible: Large flat ochre ramps/rectangles dominate the centre; their surfaces have no convincing assembly, edge treatment, scale detail or material separation.
critical_defects.why_it_fails: This is visibly a Three.js prototype rather than roof/industrial architecture. The accent colour is disproportionately large and destroys the intended material hierarchy.
critical_defects.required_fix: Reduce ochre to narrow safety/route accents. Replace primary foreground slabs with dark roof membrane, concrete risers, metal nosings, parapets, seams and a believable roof circulation structure.

critical_defects.title: Background window arrays float as repeated copy-paste rectangles
critical_defects.what_is_visible: Rows of blue-grey and occasional yellow rectangular window panels stand against the sky with little or no readable facade mass behind them.
critical_defects.why_it_fails: The scene audit's 862 facade-window instances are visible as the exact procedural-copy pattern the review must reject. The city does not read as constructed volume.
critical_defects.required_fix: Make the parent building masses legible at player height; reduce/cap window density; use clustered facade bays, structural piers, recessed glazing and silhouette variation. Do not retain window planes as standalone scenery.

critical_defects.title: Foreground occlusion and near-black shapes obstruct route readability
critical_defects.what_is_visible: Large near-black wedges at the lower right and dark planes across the lower frame hide the route; some appear as an oversized viewmodel/near geometry.
critical_defects.why_it_fails: The first-person composition loses the landing/route at the moment a player needs it most. It looks like a camera collision or unfinished mesh, not an intentional equipment viewmodel.
critical_defects.required_fix: Shrink/reposition the pulse device and audit nearby roof/parapet geometry. The lower-right screen must preserve a clear view of the next landing.

critical_defects.title: The capture sequence does not traverse the declared route
critical_defects.what_is_visible: The declared frame names promise Switch House, East Span and Boiler Court, but capture metadata places the player around Z 35 to 33, before the intake/switch-house transition.
critical_defects.why_it_fails: These frames are real captures but not valid evidence for the named regions. This is a navigation/capture defect, not a substitute for region review.
critical_defects.required_fix: Use the recorded real-player path only; classify region from actual position, fail a requested capture on a navigation miss, add fluid maintenance risers/step handling, and recapture.

critic_reviews.findings: The beige sky consumes the composition; ochre blocks become the only focal point. There is no premium visual hierarchy, landmark silhouette or authored exterior image.
critic_reviews.action: Build a darker, layered harbour silhouette and reserve amber for signals/route marks rather than whole platforms.

critic_reviews.findings: The next destination is a tiny Kinetic Permit sign over a large undifferentiated step. No landing, branch, recovery line or route priority is legible in the frame.
critic_reviews.action: Frame each approach with a destination volume, visible landing and a clear distinction between primary, fast and safe lines.

critic_reviews.findings: The screenshots do not yet describe a functioning roof/utility district. Window grids float, primary surfaces read flat, and no coherent lower world is visible.
critic_reviews.action: Prioritise silhouette-bearing buildings, roof machinery mounted to believable bases, facade depth and a lower rail/harbour world before adding more segments.

critic_reviews.findings: The captured result exposes repeated facade panels, near-black occlusion and very weak contrast between background mass and sky. The capture record also reports 727 cool-glazing instances and 862 facade-window objects.
critic_reviews.action: Reduce panel count, batch/rework facades into readably solid assemblies, establish albedo contrast before emission, and verify the player view after each geometry pass.

critic_reviews.findings: Large coloured slabs obscure rather than communicate a specific movement decision, and the automation did not reach the requested parkour regions.
critic_reviews.action: Add meaningful stair/threshold flow, expose take-off/landing surfaces in view, and recapture successful east/west route movement before judging skill expression.

critic_reviews.findings: The resting view has excessive upper sky and an obstructed lower-right quadrant. The recorded player path stalled before the planned region sequence.
critic_reviews.action: Bias default camera slightly toward the landing plane, shrink the wrist tool, add verified step handling and measure capture positions against requested regions.

critic_reviews.findings: The scene gives little reason to explore because the player sees blank sky, repetitive grids and generic ramps rather than a destination or lived-in exterior.
critic_reviews.action: Make the player see a striking connected city/bridge/harbour image and concrete route promise from the first second.

critic_reviews.findings: The record reports 1,273 registered scene objects, dominated by tiny repeated window planes, while the output still looks sparse. Browser console records GPU ReadPixels stalls during capture; it does not prove in-game frame rate but supports reducing visual waste.
critic_reviews.action: Spend geometry on a few high-value silhouette layers and facade assemblies instead of hundreds of individual window cards; profile after the visual rebuild.

critic_reviews.findings: This is visibly an unfinished prototype: a mostly blank sky, coloured slabs, black wedges and detached window grids. It is not acceptable as a real parkour-game presentation.
critic_reviews.action: Reject the current visual build. Rebuild the spawn/exterior hierarchy first; do not advance to score or polish later regions until the first 20 seconds are visually credible.

iteration_directive.next_capture_requirement: After the major spawn/exterior and first-transition changes, capture the same player-height dispatch forward/east/west views plus verified arrival frames. Do not reuse this review after that geometry/material revision.
iteration_directive.approval_rule: No critic is approving these frames. Scores are diagnostic for this immutable review round only and must not be treated as a completion score.
